title: worker ps
description: Every worker at a glance - the dispatcher's cheap poll (tmux + locks only, no git/gh). One row per slot: worker live/dead/none, activity working/idle/waiting, and the task its lock carries. Use sm_slot_ls when you need reusability.

watch.description: redraw the table on an interval until Ctrl-C (alias: --follow)

follow.description: alias for --watch (one word works across ls/ps/logs)
